protocol.scheme: diagonal: variant v evaluated on batch v
protocol.comment: FROZEN L3 protocol (D18): 10 variants x 20 envs = 200 episodes with 200 DISTINCT poses. Batch 0 on every variant would also total 200 episodes but only 20 distinct poses, since variants share the pose RNG stream. L0-L2 use 100 episodes (5 batches x 20); L3's 200 is the frozen design, so L3 carries a tighter CI than L0-L2 by construction.
